latHint: Think fretting over a mistake - not a pot of dinner.
pivHint: A STEW simmers in the slow cooker - but to STEW over a mistake means to do what?
winText: Losing sleep. STEW was the pivot - a simmering pot to WORRYing.
lossText: WORRY - to fret. STEW was the pivot: simmering STEW to STEWing over something.
